# Signature fixtures

These StarCraft II bank files are synthetic and contain synthetic account handles.
Expected digests use manually assembled canonical bytes hashed independently with
Python's SHA-1. [Historical evidence](../../../../../docs/verification/VERIFICATION_REGISTER.md#historical-evidence)

| Fixture | Author / player / bank name | Expected digest |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `case-ties.sc2bank` | `1-S2-1-1001` / `2-S2-1-2002` / `Bank` | `400CCD1D17B653D68BE2FE645A694FB016C3105D` |
| `case-swapped-ties.sc2bank` | `1-S2-1-1001` / `2-S2-1-2002` / `Bank` | `5B7E8B16CEF62A229D8A659498571B039B4F7040` |
| `canonical-ascii.sc2bank` | `1-S2-1-0` / `1-S2-1-0` / `Fixture` | `9689A338F3C1C57C9090E476B6A5F60336C17DAC` |
| `canonical-ordinal.sc2bank` | `1-S2-1-0` / `1-S2-1-0` / `Fixture` | `55C56FBE432B737EB534DE691B9A410375C4234F` |
